sourceTitle: Great Indian Chief of the West; Or, Life and Adventures of Black Hawk
description: "Great Indian Chief of the West; Or, Life and Adventures of Black Hawk" by Drake is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The narrative focuses on the life of Black Hawk, a prominent leader of the Sac and Fox tribes, chronicling his experiences, battles, and the complex relations between Native Americans and the United States government.
longDescription: Source subjects: Black Hawk, Sauk chief, 1767-1838; Black Hawk War, 1832; Keokuk, Sauk chief, 1780?-1848.
